Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo? We noticed a recent usage spike on your account

Hi Ethan,

Congrats — I noticed your team at DemoApp hit a sudden usage uptick over the last 48 hours (nice work!). I’m Aditya on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. We try to proactively reach out when someone starts pushing the limits of the self-serve experience so we can help ensure performance and cost are aligned with your goals.

If you have 20–30 minutes this week we can:
- Walk through how you’re using the API (common cost/latency optimizations)
- Show a quick demo tailored to your workload and batching patterns
- Outline a few low-friction next steps (sandbox Dedicated/demo environment)

Proposed times (PST):
• Fri 3/5 11:00 – 11:30
• Mon 3/8 10:00 – 10:30
• Mon 3/8 15:00 – 15:30

If those don’t work tell me what’s better and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ll also loop in Ben (SE) if you want a brief technical deep-dive.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks for reaching out — yes that spike is intentional as we ramped a new prompt into production. I’d love a short walkthrough to make sure we’re not wasting tokens and latency is acceptable for our worst-case flows.

Mon 3/8 at 10:00 PST works for me. Could you include a short checklist of what you’ll review? Also, I may invite our backend lead (Marta Lopez) to ask about KV cache patterns.

Best,
